full_judgment: 7. The learned Advocates appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that both the courts below in passing the judgment and dismissal decree and in disallowing the appeal committed illegality and irregularity resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice. The learned Advocates further submits that none of the courts considered the facts of the case as to the effect that no paper has been filed to substantiate the delivery of possession pursuant to alleged settlement in favour of defendant-opposite parties. There has been total non-consideration of material facts resulting in an error in the decision occasioning miscarriage of justice. There is no paper from the side of the defendants that MT Brown Estate ever managed the property under the management of court of Wards and there is no evidence to show that the alleged settlement was granted in favour of the defendant by the Court of Wards. Both the Courts below on surmise and conjecture holding the correctness of the alleged settlement and auction purchase committed error of law. Neither the trial court nor the appellate court considered that there is no evidence of annulment and taking possession of the land by the government. Petty Settlement Khatian marked Exhibits-'Ka-3' and 'Ka-4' shows that the government was not the land-lord which is also not considered by the courts below. It was the case of the plaintiffs that Jonab Ali the predecessor of the defendants created the papers of auction and settlement by the act of fraud and forgery which has vitiated the alleged auction and settlement. The learned Advocates also submit that the courts below misdirected themselves on the question of payment of rent which is on the basis of wrong SA Khatian which has no presumptive value of correctness. The courts below also not considered the evidence of the defendant's witness No.6 who has admitted the possession of the plaintiff-petitioners and their homestead. The learned Advocates lastly submit that it is the case of the defendants that they took pattan from the landlord through 'amaldari dakhila' not by kabuliat. The CS khatian is a title document which proves the bona fide of the plain-tiffs and the evidence adduced from the side of the parties not properly assessed by the learned lower appellate court in its true perspective and there is non-reading and misreading of evidence and non-consideration to material facts in disposing the appeal which is violative to the provisions laid down under Order XLI, rule 31 of the Code of Civil Procedure and, as such, the impugned judgment and decree is not sustainable.
